full_page.content:
Page 13 Cont.
Alex C. Purvis - 69 - heart .. arthritis Mary Painter - Arthritis James Mason -11- Blood poison - pneumonia, blood transfusion every day
Hugh A. McKimion - Heart Wm.
Dec. 26 Wm. Neuhauser - 12 has not walked for over a year - "Muscular Distro- phy" Enrolled To-day for year folks promising frequent Com ..... has not been to Confes'n in 18 yrs .... Jan. 15 can move leg and arm ...
Ellen Sprutti - 16 - "atheletic foot" seems spreading to other limbs. Enrolled To-day 1:00 - Her father was given up a hopeless case as little boy ... now has family of nine.
Page 14
Dec. 19 Francis Yinger double fractured scol Mrs. Cunningham 68 - cold since September. McPherson Case in Harper Miss Ellen Bernardini - Proode Fr. Coughlin
Louzia Maskill - 64 - inward cancer & tuomer ... fears operation has been hemoraging five yrs ....
29 John Cha's Kulbacki - 6 - blind since 3 weeks old: was enrolled in Ser. M. Ass'n 6 weeks ago. On Xmas Day when at the "Crib" here in Church, was almost frightened as he exclaimed pointing to the lighed up crib: "Look Mama", Deo Gr.
Lillie Levcovitz - Jewish - Eyes --- three years ...
Sheilia Demery - 22 - given up by "all the doctor in Florida - last April or May - is now in perfect health - Father promised $500.00 for Masses.
